title: Visit
description: Record the clinical findings for this assigned appointment.

start.title: Ready to start?
start.description: Starting the Visit changes the appointment to In progress.

open.title: Clinical record
open.description: Save a draft whenever you need to retain clinical findings.
open.completeRequiresContent: Save content in at least one clinical field before completing this Visit.
open.saveBeforeComplete: Save the current changes before completing this Visit.

completeDialog.title: Complete this Visit?
completeDialog.description: The original clinical record will be locked. Further corrections must be added as an addendum.

completed.originalContentDescription: This content was locked when the Visit was completed.

addendum.title: Addenda
addendum.description: Addenda preserve the original clinical record and are shown in the order they were added.
addendum.createDescription: Record a correction or follow-up note without changing the original Visit.

errors.appointmentLoad: Could not load the assigned appointment.

states.invalidLinkDescription: Open the Visit from an appointment in your schedule.
states.notFoundDescription: This appointment may not belong to you or may not be scheduled on the selected date.
states.unavailableDescription: The patient must be checked in before the Visit can start.
